claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: TC1 is a BACE1 inhibitor with no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; the retrieved abstracts concern immunology and cancer immunotherapy unrelated to BACE1, so the compound is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
